source.label: Netflix public catalogue · TV series & shows
source.note: Collected from rendered official Netflix public genre pages and their observed genre links, without authentication or hidden APIs. Netflix title IDs deduplicated globally across all three screen batches. Posters are observed remote URLs; rights remain with their owners. Public listings are not a verified full or region-specific playback inventory. Classification is catalogue-based; anime includes Western animation. Snapshot only.
